todos.description: Fix scripts/predict_tc.py: deduplicate all function definitions (predict_tc, train_model, main, average_valence, average_debye, average_atomic_mass, allen_dynes_tc, generate_candidates, structure_to_graph — each defined 2-4 times), remove the dangling docstring syntax error after the first predict_tc() body, and fix the module-level load_database() call to load from data/superconductor_database.json instead of superconductor_data.json. Consolidate multiple main() into a single entry point with argparse.

Fix run_pipeline.py: create scripts/output_ranked.py with a run() function to resolve the ImportError from importlib.import_module('output_ranked'), and remove the duplicate reproducibility_check() function definition (keep one). Also wrap missing-dependency imports (stable_baselines3, pulp, GPy, simpy, SALib, mp_api, cryptography, prometheus_client, slowapi) in try/except blocks so the pipeline can at least start without them.

Fix streamlit_dashboard.py: (1) Increase st.tabs() from 8 to 11 tabs (or remove references to tab9/10/11), (2) remove orphaned elif/if blocks in collaboration_hub_tab() that reference undefined variable 'tab', (3) remove non-existent imports (live_external_validation, what_if_analysis, generate_monthly_report) from the 'from run_pipeline import ...' line, (4) remove the duplicate 'tabs' redefinition at the bottom of the file, and (5) move display_candidate_materials() call inside main() or guard with if __name__ == '__main__'.

Fix dft_calculator.py: define a standalone structure_to_graph() function at module level (currently only exists as MLTcPredictor._structure_to_graph() method) so compute_ab_initio_tc() doesn't raise NameError. Also wrap torch_geometric, shap, ase imports in try/except blocks with graceful fallbacks to sklearn-only models.

Fix tests/test_api_client.py: update test calls to fetch_materials_project() and fetch_icsd() to pass a mock api_key as the first positional argument (e.g., fetch_materials_project('mock_key', 'H3S')), matching the actual function signatures in scripts/api_client.py.
